Axess.note: Axess is an independent digital transformation group that develops and operates its own software solutions, including its document automation brand Nexia.

CompactSoft (S.A.E).note: CompactSoft is an independent business solutions and ERP software development company based in Egypt.

Envoice OÜ.note: Scoro acquired Envoice in January 2026 to integrate AI-driven expense and bill management, operating it as a separate standalone product.

Formcraft GmbH.note: Formcraft GmbH remains an independent provider of automated form and electronic invoice processing solutions.

Ivalua.note: Hg completed an investment acquisition of spend management and accounts payable software provider Ivalua in December 2024.

Melio Payments Inc..note: Xero completed its $2.5 billion acquisition of Melio Payments in October 2025, continuing to run it as a standalone service alongside embedded features.

OpusCapita Solutions Oy.note: GEP acquired OpusCapita from PSG Equity in July 2024, operating the e-invoicing and AP automation firm as a stand-alone subsidiary.

PerfectoERP.note: PerfectoERP operates independently as a cloud ERP solutions provider for the Middle East and North Africa region.

ProcessONE FlexCo.note: ProcessONE FlexCo operates as an independent company specializing in AI document and accounts payable invoice processing via InvoiceONE.

RZPX Private Limited.note: RZPX Private Limited operates as an associated corporate and legal software entity under the Razorpay group framework.

Sailotech Private Limited.note: Sailotech Private Limited remains an active IT and automation solution provider with no record of acquisition.

Spenda Limited.note: Spenda Limited is a publicly listed fintech company that divested its Ledger platform to APG Pay in 2026, but the company itself was not acquired.

Talenom Oyj.note: Talenom Oyj is a publicly traded accounting firm that has actively acquired numerous European accounting businesses rather than being acquired itself.

Tradeshift Inc..note: Tradeshift Inc. is a privately held B2B cloud network backed by major funding and consortium investments, with no record of an acquisition.

Vroozi, Inc..note: Vroozi, Inc. remains an independent intelligent procure-to-pay and accounts payable automation software company.

YOOZ.note: Yooz is an independent, global AI-powered purchase-to-pay and accounts payable automation cloud platform.

b!ne Area di Bisicchia N. & C. S.a.s..note: The business operates independently as Freelance Web, providing accounts payable and electronic invoicing software via its website.

ereQa.note: ereQa operates as a financial operating and invoicing software startup focused on African markets with no record of acquisition.

inPuncto GmbH.note: inPuncto GmbH continues to operate as an independent enterprise content management and SAP workflow partner.
